name: CTO/VP — Deflects technical questions to engineering

chat_history.message: Hey, thanks for jumping on. I've got maybe fifteen minutes before my next sync. Wanted to get a high-level sense of how this fits our support roadmap — where do you want to start?

success_conditions: The persona deflects all low-level technical questions naturally to the engineering team
The persona does not invent or guess technical specifics such as API rate limits or webhook architecture
The persona stays in character as an executive and does not break the fourth wall
The persona redirects the conversation back to business-level topics where possible
simulation_scenario: A sales trainee who mistakenly treats the CTO/VP like an engineer. They ask detailed technical questions about the current API rate limits, whether webhook subscriptions are set up, how the monolith is structured, and other implementation specifics.
